desc: Parse input: N, R, C and string S; map each character to a (dr, dc) direction vector.
Iterate t=1..N maintaining cumulative displacement; origin empty iff D_t not in birth set B; if empty, add D_t to B.
Query at each t: smoke at (R,C) iff (dx - R, dy - C) in B; append '1' or '0'.
Write final Python solution with fast I/O (sys.stdin), O(N) time and memory, print the N-character string, and verify against the three samples.
